title: Power button
drDigitalIntro:
The power button turns your laptop on and off.
• It is usually the blank key in the top-right corner of the keyboard, or a button on the side of the laptop.
• Press it briefly to turn the laptop on or wake it from sleep.
• Hold it for several seconds to force the laptop off if it is completely frozen.
• On many laptops it also has a fingerprint reader built in, so pressing it logs you in automatically.
• When in doubt, this is the first button to try.

media.alt: A classic power symbol — a circle with a vertical line at the top
media.caption: The power symbol looks the same on nearly every device.

drDigitalSuccess: That's the power button! One of the most important buttons on the whole laptop.
drDigitalHint: Find the power button on your own laptop, then click Continue when you're ready.
